How It Works

Describe what you need, review what it builds, and keep moving.

1

Describe the Task

"Set up the forest tilemap." "Add an inventory system." "Fix the player knockback." Just describe it in plain English.

2

It Drafts the Implementation

Scripts, scenes, prefabs, UI, game logic — CircuitBot writes a working first draft. Less time on boilerplate, more time on creative decisions.

3

Review and Refine

Open your engine, review the changes, and tweak as needed. You stay in control — keep it, adjust it, or ask for a different approach.

Your Team's Force Multiplier

Handle more work without hiring more people. CircuitBot takes on the tasks your team doesn't have time for.

@

Natural Language Tasks

"Add a double-jump." "Set up the shop UI." Describe what you need and CircuitBot writes the first pass — C#, GDScript, C++, shaders, scene files.

#

Multiple Games at Once

Working on multiple titles? CircuitBot handles them all. One bot per studio, unlimited projects, each with its own context.

AI

Fast or Powerful — You Pick

Quick bug fix? Use the fast model. Complex system design? Switch to advanced. Choose per task, optimize your budget.

//
